name: AAA-SA-gas-prices
what_it_holds: Git-scraping style repo (simonw pattern) that scrapes San Antonio, TX average gas prices from AAA's site 4x/day; full history lives in the git commit log of the tracked data file rather than in separate dated files.
why_useful: Single-city but very high frequency (4x daily) AAA gas price series via git history -- a template for point-in-time gas price vintages if the git log is mined; low standalone value for ABNB (one city) but a useful method example.
size_hint: single small CSV/JSON, history in git log

name: NHTS2001
what_it_holds: Compressed 2001 National Household Travel Survey public-use dataset (household/person/vehicle/trip files), packaged for use in the VisionEval travel-demand modeling framework.
why_useful: Oldest committed NHTS wave found on GitHub (2001) -- useful as a historical baseline for pre-STR-era household travel/driving behavior if a long time-series comparison of road-trip share of travel is ever built.
size_hint: compressed microdata files, national household survey scale (tens of thousands of records)
themes: Road travel and fuel: gas prices (EIA, AAA), vehicle miles travelled, holiday driving, toll data
why_all: Oldest committed NHTS wave found on GitHub (2001) -- useful as a historical baseline for pre-STR-era household travel/driving behavior if a long time-series comparison of road-trip share of travel is ever built.

name: fuel-price-finder

Appears to be a build tutorial/app rather than a data archive; geography and source unclear from snippet (needs verification of underlying feed, likely US or UK government open fuel-price feed).

name: SkiResortScraper
what_it_holds: Python web scraper targeting www.skiresort.info to pull global ski-resort details, statistics (slope km, lift counts, snow reliability ratings) and user reviews. No visitation/skier-day counts committed — it's a scraper against a third-party non-Airbnb site, not raw data in-repo.
why_useful: Could be run (as a method, not pre-built dataset) to build a global ski-resort attribute/rating panel as a winter-destination demand proxy; skiresort.info itself doesn't appear to publish skier-visit counts, only facility stats and ratings, so value is limited to a facility census rather than attendance volume.
themes: Destination demand proxies: US National Park Service visitation stats API, state park attendance, museum/theme-park attendance, ski resort data, beach visitation
why_all: Could be run (as a method, not pre-built dataset) to build a global ski-resort attribute/rating panel as a winter-destination demand proxy; skiresort.info itself doesn't appear to publish skier-visit counts, only facility stats and ratings, so value is limited to a facility census rather than attendance volume.
